items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: So we brought in Nelson Williams, who used to be on the USO tour with me...

ctx.x: trumpet player. So we brought in Nelson Williams, who used to be on the USO tour with me... Oh yeah, that's right. He was on the USO tour with me, and he brought him in the band. Good trumpet player. So we go out to this hotel in St. Louis and played the engagement there. Beautiful. In the meantime, Kirby was booked into this Cosmopolitan place in Milwaukee. He was booked in there for the third time now.

Okay, so we go back there, and Nelson Williams -- that's the time he was with us; that's his first time with us. And everybody was talking about how good the band sounds, it sounds better than ever, and so forth and so on...
